Return both ratios rounded to 2 decimal places and the more traffic-dominated pollutant name.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Define the time range for October 2025
start_date = '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
end_date = '2025-11-01 00:00:00'

# Query the average NO2 and PM2.5 for roadside and general stations
query = text(f"""
WITH station_data AS (
    SELECT
        station_type,
        AVG(no2) AS avg_no2,
        AVG(pm2_5) AS avg_pm2_5
    FROM
        hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
    JOIN
        air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
    WHERE
        hsaq.datetime >= '{start_date}' AND hsaq.datetime < '{end_date}'
    GROUP BY
        station_type
)
SELECT
    station_type,
    avg_no2,
    avg_pm2_5
FROM
    station_data
""")

# Execute the query and load the results into a DataFrame
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Calculate the ratios
roadside_no2 = df.loc[df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE', 'avg_no2'].values[0]
general_no2 = df.loc[df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL', 'avg_no2'].values[0]
roadside_pm25 = df.loc[df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE', 'avg_pm2_5'].values[0]
general_pm25 = df.loc[df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL', 'avg_pm2_5'].values[0]

no2_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_no2 / general_no2, 2)
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = round(roadside_pm25 / general_pm25, 2)

# Determine which pollutant has a larger roadside enhancement
if no2_roadside_general_ratio > pm25_roadside_general_ratio:
    more_traffic_dominated = 'NO2'
else:
    more_traffic_dominated = 'PM2.5'

# Print the results
print(f"NO2 roadside-to-general ratio: {no2_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"PM2.5 roadside-to-general ratio: {pm25_roadside_general_ratio}")
print(f"More traffic-dominated pollutant: {more_traffic_dominated}")

# Assign the results to the required variables
no2_roadside_general_ratio = no2_roadside_general_ratio
pm25_roadside_general_ratio = pm25_roadside_general_ratio
more_traffic_dominated = more_traffic_dominated

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Define the time range for October 2025
start_date = '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
end_date = '2025-11-01 00:00:00'

# Define the time ranges for rush hours and off-peak hours
rush_hours = "EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) IN (8, 17, 18)"
offpeak_hours = "EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15)"

# Query the average NO2 and PM2.5 for roadside stations during rush hours and off-peak hours
query = text(f"""
WITH roadside_data AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN {rush_hours} THEN 'rush'
            WHEN {offpeak_hours} THEN 'offpeak'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS period,
        AVG(no2) AS avg_no2,
        AVG(pm2_5) AS avg_pm2_5
    FROM
        hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
    JOIN
        air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
    WHERE
        hsaq.datetime >= '{start_date}' AND hsaq.datetime < '{end_date}'
        AND aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
    GROUP BY
        period
)
SELECT
    period,
    avg_no2,
    avg_pm2_5,
    (avg_no2 / avg_pm2_5) AS no2_pm25_ratio
FROM
    roadside_data
WHERE
    period IN ('rush', 'offpeak')
""")

# Execute the query and load the results into a DataFrame
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Extract the ratios
rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(df.loc[df['period'] == 'rush', 'no2_pm25_ratio'].values[0], 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(df.loc[df['period'] == 'offpeak', 'no2_pm25_ratio'].values[0], 2)

# Print the results
print(f"Average NO2/PM2.5 ratio during rush hours: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Average NO2/PM2.5 ratio during off-peak hours: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

# Assign the results to the required variables
rush_no2_pm25_ratio = rush_no2_pm25_ratio
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio
